name: Train Sim World 6: Cargo Line Vol. 6 - Gas
summary: Discover different freight traffic with Skyhook Games' Cargo Line for Train Sim World. In Vol. 6, hop to Mannheim - Kaiserslautern for the first German pack! Don't let the pressure get to you as you turn up the heat with Zags Gas Tankers in-tow.
